sharedRules.name: Stabiliser
sharedRules.description: Insted of having a reduced Moving ROF, weapons with Stabiliser suffer a +1 penalty to hit if the shooting Tank Moved in the Moving Step

sharedRules.name: Blood'n Guts
sharedRules.description: Tanks with Blood'n Guts have better Last Stand ratings. Infantry and Guns with Blood'n Guts have better Rally ratings.

sharedRules.name: Self-Defence AA
sharedRules.description: Self-Defence AA weapons can Shoot at Aircraft with ROF 1.

sharedRules.name: SP Gun
sharedRules.description: SP Guns have a worse Counterattack rating and a worse Assault rating. If they are Open-topped they have a significantly worse Counterattack rating.

sharedRules.name: No HE
sharedRules.description: A weapon with No HE targeting an Infantry or Gun Team, adds +1 to the score needed To Hit.

sharedRules.name: Smoke
sharedRules.description: Smoke weapons can Shoot Smoke ammunition.

sharedRules.name: Seek, Strike and Destroy
sharedRules.description: A Unit with Seek, Strike and Destroy my attempt a Shoot and Scoot Movement Order after succeeding with a Blitz Move Movment Order earlier in the same turn.

sharedRules.name: Overworked
sharedRules.description: Overworked weapons add +1 to the scort To Hit when moving.

sharedRules.name: Scout
sharedRules.description:
Scouts are Gone to Ground unless they Shoot or Assault. This means that if they are Conseald, they enemy will suffer an additional +1 penelty to hit them.

Scouts have a worse Last Stand rating, Open or Wheeled Scout tanks have a significantly worse Counterattack rating and a worse Assault rating as well.

sharedRules.name: Component
sharedRules.description: Component Teams rule use the same rating of their parent Unit.

sharedRules.name: Observer
sharedRules.description: The Unit Leader of a Unit with Observer can spot for any friendly Artilery Unit.

sharedRules.name: Heavy Weapon
sharedRules.description: A Heavy Weapon Team cannot Charge into Contact, but may be an Assaulting Team if in Contact with an enemy Team. Heavy Weapons have a worse Assault rating.

sharedRules.name: Assault 5+
sharedRules.description: Teams with the Assault # special rule uses # number for To Hit rolls in Assaults rather than the normal one shown on the card.

sharedRules.name: Gun Shield
sharedRules.description: A Gun Team with the Gun Shield is in Bulletproof Cover when Shot at from in front of the Team's base. A Gun Shield does not offer any protection against Artillery Bombardments or if the Team moved at Dash speed.

sharedRules.name: Time on Target
sharedRules.description: If an Artillery Unit with Time on Targer ranges in on the first attempt, any Infantry or Gun Teams hit by the Bombardment must re-roll successful Saves.

sharedRules.name: MG Transport
sharedRules.description: M1917 HMG or M1919 LMG teams my fire while Monunted as a Passenger in an M3 half-track, using the Optional Passenger MG weapon line.

sharedRules.name: Combat Engineer
sharedRules.description:
Infantry Teams in this Formation cross Minefields safely on a roll of 3+.
Indantry Units in this Formatiopn Dig In on a roll of 3+.

rules.name: Passengers 6
rules.description: Team can carry six Infantry Teams as Passangers

rules.name: Tractor
rules.description: Team can carry one Gun Team as Passangers.

rules.name: Softskin
rules.description: If a Transport is Destroyed, any Passangers it is carrying are also Destroyed, and all Tranports must be Sent to the Rear immediately. All Passangers must Dismount from this Unit at the same time. Empty Tranpost Teams must be Sent to the Rear

rules.name: Unarmoured
rules.description: Tram cannot Charge into Contact and must Break Off if Assaulted

rules.name: Lucky
rules.description: Discard this card to re-roll any one die. The second result must be used.
